description: CCW plate heat exchanger A (2 x 100 %)
material: Titanium plates, EPDM gaskets, CS frame
remarks: Duty 10,000 kW (about 9 MW estimated: GT generator about 3.8, ST generator about 1.8, GT lube/hydraulic about 1.5, ST lube/EHC about 0.7, BFP/CEP/compressors/SWAS about 1.2, +10 % margin); CCW side 35/45 degC, 860 t/h. Seawater side about 1,100 m3/h from CW system at up to 27 degC.
